AI gives you leverage

Get better at AI, not just the process

£1,500 deposit + £2,100 balance · about 2 months

Here's what it costs: a £1,500 deposit, then a £2,100 balance.
I've paid both, and the process takes about two months. Don't try to do it with AI alone.
Learn the process, delegate with AI, and still use a professional.
Using AI gives you leverage, so use it on processes like this to get better at AI, not just to finish one.
